summary: Implementation phase -- the first live Runtime Context object model, using the contracts frozen in 112A/112B, preserving every non-executing guarantee established through 112B.1. Added src/pcae/core/runtime_context.py, implementing all twelve objects 112A froze as inert, immutable (frozen dataclass) records, importing only dataclasses/typing (no broker, no registry, no shell, no subprocess, no network). Every identity (session_id through observation_id, plus the three future placeholders) is required and fail-closed-validated non-empty at construction, enforcing 112B's Identity is immutable and precedes state invariant at the one point it can be enforced; RuntimeContext has no independent identity (112B section 2). Implemented via composition -- RuntimeContext contains RuntimeSession, which contains TaskContext/ObservationContext; PhaseContext contains IntentContext; the chain composes through BrokerDecisionContext to ApprovalContext to EvidenceContext -- with TaskContext referencing its phase_id rather than nesting a copy, since Task:Phase cardinality is many-to-one (112B section 6/8.1). Deliberately implements 112B's resolved Broker-Decision-before-Approval ordering rather than this phase's own brief's pre-resolution diagram, since objective 1 asked for an implementation exactly matching 112B's frozen contracts -- documented explicitly as a deviation, not a silent reversion. Every object carries a lifecycle_stage field (112A's six-stage vocabulary); the only implemented transition (observe_context()) moves Created/Initialized to Observed, returning a new immutable instance -- no complete()/archive()/update() exists on any class. Every class carries class-level OWNERSHIP (112B section 4) and PERSISTENCE_BUCKET (112B section 5) metadata, represented but never enforced. Repaired three stale forward-looking guard tests (111R/112A/112B) that asserted runtime_context.py must not exist -- their intended outcome, not a regression -- and fixed one latent glob bug found during the same pass (112B's own glob also matched 112B.1's task contract). 105 new tests (tests/test_runtime_context.py). Added docs/PHASE_112_RUNTIME_CONTEXT_PROTOTYPE.md. Focused tests (997), governance/autonomy group (2714), and the full release/lifecycle regression suite including the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files (1497/1497) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4389/4390 (one pre-existing, unrelated failure confirmed present on clean HEAD before this phase's own changes -- test_dry_run_simulation.py Test89dMatrixReadOnly::test_pytest_dry_run_not_blocked, which depends on live repo/task state rather than being a hermetic unit test; out of this phase's scope to repair).
